verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents its own programmatic glTF importer (docs-6) and headless, server-side operation via NullEngine (docs-2, docs-3), so assets are loaded through code rather than hand-clicking. The pack shows only page titles, though, with no description of import hooks, presets, or batch pipeline tooling, so support is thin. Missing for 10: documented import hooks/callbacks, import presets, batch or pipeline scripting for processing incoming assets, and hands-on corroboration of automated import workflows.
